Day 1 — Old Town (2026-09-14)

Everything today sits within Old Town, a short walk from the hotel — deliberately chosen to minimize backtracking per the accommodation constraint. Castle first while queues are shorter, a relaxed walk down the Royal Mile, and Camera Obscura in the afternoon as a lighter, interactive stop that works well for a 6-year-old.

Day 2 — Holyrood Park / Southside (2026-09-15)

A lighter day built around Arthur's Seat and the National Museum of Scotland. The summit ascent is skipped in favor of the shorter Dunsapie Loch viewpoint path, given the family's stamina constraint, and the museum's free, unhurried, indoor format works as a natural afternoon wind-down — and a rain backup, per the soft weather constraint.
